description: Source code for the TbJsSwitchNode class, a rule engine node in Thingsboard that routes messages based on a script evaluation, supporting TBEL or JavaScript.

classes.name: TbJsSwitchNode
classes.description: A rule engine node that routes messages based on script evaluation, supporting TBEL or JavaScript.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node, setting up the script engine based on configuration.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, executing the script asynchronously and processing the result.

methods.name: processSwitch
methods.description: Routes the message to the next nodes based on the script evaluation result.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, destroying the script engine if initialized.
